headline: High fuel prices: government seeks funds to extend discount on diesel and petrol
summary: The Italian government is looking for new funding to extend the diesel discount expiring on August 6 and is considering petrol aid. July's extra VAT revenue is not enough, and a bonus of 80-100 euros is also under consideration.
why: Fuel excise and VAT policy directly affect pump prices, consumer spending and state revenues in Italy.
